environment: local developer workstation; disposable master_saas_test, the new master_saas_test_reset, and master_saas_demo on loopback PostgreSQL. The client walkthrough ran against the local production build on port 3100. No staging or production access.
notes: CONV-015 closed by isolation rather than by another guard. tests/hr/demo-reset.spec.ts now owns <ambient>_reset, created and migrated by tests/helpers/isolated-db.ts on every run; its Prisma client and every seed subprocess point there, while the two gate cases that assert a refusal on a production- or staging-shaped database name still supply their own URL. The reset and persona suites then pass together at the default file parallelism CI uses.

Both prior mitigations were removed from tests/security/demo-personas.spec.ts, not kept. A bounded retry that waits for a fixture to be rebuilt would absorb a genuine 401 regression identically, and that file is where tenant isolation and platform-control-plane denial are asserted. Removing them raises the sensitivity of the security assertions.

CONV-016 found while running the full eslint rather than the test suite: a literal 0x08 byte in demo-reset-coverage.spec.ts made its explicit-deletion regex match nothing and made npm run lint exit 1. Fixed; the expression now finds 47 models. A scan of all 901 tracked and untracked TypeScript and JavaScript sources found it as the only stray control character in the repository.

Stability is four consecutive full-suite runs at default parallelism, not one. Baseline before the fix was 6 failed and 1986 passed; after, 1992 passed with 2 skipped in every run, so the six became passes and no test was lost or skipped to get there.
EVC-020 still holds: the SDD tooling suites report 91/93 and 69/70 on Windows, on exactly the three cases that document records, and none of them is touched by this work.
EVC-023 raised: npm run format:check cannot pass on a Windows checkout because of line endings, so a repository-wide format result from here is not evidence about that gate.
